config.enabled: Turn srmd on for this workspace: load the notes of its folder, show the Flashcards view and Explorer badges, and watch for changes. Off by default, so other projects are never searched. The Turn On and Turn Off commands and the status bar item set it in the workspace settings; set it in your user settings to turn srmd on everywhere.
config.rollover: Local time when the review day starts (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS).
config.inactive.front: Show inactive clozes on the front of a card.
config.inactive.back: Show inactive clozes on the back of a card.
config.queueOrder: Order in which review queues are served: cards seen earlier today and due again (intraday), cards due from earlier days (interday), and new cards. List each queue once.
